import React from 'react'; import { Link } from 'react-router-dom'; import { FaGraduationCap, FaChalkboardTeacher, FaUserShield, FaCalendarAlt, FaBullhorn, FaAward, FaArrowRight, FaCheckCircle, } from 'react-icons/fa'; import Navbar from '../components/common/Navbar'; import Footer from '../components/common/Footer'; import CustomCursor from '../components/common/CustomCursor'; import './LandingPage.css'; const LandingPage = () => { return (
{/* Hero Section */}
Your campus, in its element

EventSphere

Smart Campus Event and Communication Portal

Find your people, try something new, and make every campus moment count. One lively hub for students, faculty, and the events that bring them together.

Find your next event Join the campus
Discover Connect Celebrate
{/* Login Portals Section */}
A place for every campus role

Pick your path

Sign in to your space and make something great happen on campus.

{/* Student Card */}
Students

Student Portal

Find the workshops, celebrations, and new interests you didn’t know you were looking for.

  • Explore & register for events
  • Track your attendance record
  • Download verified certificates
Student Login
Don't have an account?{' '} Sign up here
{/* Teacher Card */}
Faculty

Faculty Portal

Bring good ideas to life with easy event planning, clear updates, and smoother attendance.

  • Create & coordinate events
  • Filter & assign student cohorts
  • Take real-time attendance
Teacher Login
New faculty member?{' '} Register here
{/* Admin Card */}
Administration

Admin Portal

Keep your campus community connected with thoughtful oversight and helpful insights.

  • Approve faculty applications
  • Departmental analytics & charts
  • System-wide audits & reports
Admin Login
Restricted to authorized system administrators.
{/* Features Overview */}
Good things happen together

More than a calendar

Little tools that make it easier to show up, get involved, and feel part of campus.

Make something happen

Turn a seminar, club meetup, or big idea into an event everyone can find and join.

Keep everyone in the loop

Share the right updates with the right people, so no one misses the moment.

Celebrate your milestones

Keep a record of the events you attend and download certificates for your achievements.
